## Summary

Added slug-based post URLs while keeping id-based edit/update/delete intact:

- **`db/schema.ts`**: added a `slug` column (`text`, not null, unique) to `posts`.
- **`db/migrations/20260818095057_add_slug_to_posts/`**: generated migration, hand-edited to add the column nullable first, backfill existing rows with `'post-' || id`, then rebuild the table with the `NOT NULL UNIQUE` constraint — SQLite rejects `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN NOT NULL` outright on a non-empty table, so this keeps upgrades of a populated dev database working.
- **`app/Models/Post.ts`**: added `slugify()` (lowercase, ASCII-only, hyphen-joined) and `Post.uniqueSlug(title)`, which probes `base`, `base-2`, `base-3`, … for the next free slug.
- **`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`**: `store()` generates the slug once at creation via `forceCreate` (never from request input) and redirects to `/posts/<slug>`; `update()` no longer touches the slug and redirects to the stable slug URL; `show()` now takes `/posts/:slug` — a purely numeric segment is looked up as a legacy id and 301-redirected to the slug URL (404 if unknown), anything else is looked up by slug (404 if unknown).
- **`app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`**: added `PostSlugParamSchema`.
- **`app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`**: `PostResourceData` now carries `slug`.
- **`routes/web.ts`**: `posts.show` path changed from `/posts/:id` to `/posts/:slug`.
- **`resources/js/pages/Home.tsx`** and **`posts/Index.tsx`**: post links now point at the slug URL.
- **`db/seeders/002_posts.ts`**: sample posts now seed explicit slugs (seeder inserts bypass the model).
- Regenerated `.guren/*.gen.ts` via `bun run codegen`.
- Added `tests/PostSlug.test.ts` covering slugify formatting, suffix collision handling, create→redirect, slug stability across title edits, slug-URL show, unknown-slug 404, numeric-id 301 redirect, and unknown-id 404.
